claim: CloudFront can automatically compress your text or binary data. You turn it on in your cache behavior settings, and the client has to add Accept-Encoding: gzip to the request header.
question: How does CloudFront gzip compression get turned on, and what must the client send?

values.display: cache behavior settings
Accept-Encoding: gzip

qualifiers.condition: the client adds Accept-Encoding: gzip; most modern web browsers do this by default

evidence.quote: Yes, CloudFront can automatically compress your text or binary data.

To use the feature, simply specify in your cache behavior settings that you would like CloudFront to compress objects automatically and ensure that your client adds Accept-Encoding: gzip in the request header (most modern web browsers do this by default).
